placeholders.description: The placeholder census. \ph{<id>} sites are not numerals and must not appear in unsourced_numbers — 'not yet measured' and 'invented' are different defects and only one of them is fixable by the author. What this census catches instead is drift: a site the writer emitted without reporting, a registered placeholder with no site, an id spelled two ways, and — the serious one — a real number sitting where the brief registered a placeholder.

sites.description: Every \ph{<id>} site found in the manuscript text, tables and figure captions.

registered_open.description: How many of the brief's placeholders are still status 'open'.

mismatches.description: Every disagreement between the brief's registry and the text. Empty is the only clean value.

unsourced_numbers.description: A numeral with no producing file. The single most damaging class of defect.

searched.description: Where you looked before concluding it has no source.

evidence.description: The file and value that contradicts it, or 'no file establishes this claim'.

terminology_pairs.description: Synonym pairs found, each with both locations.

checked_scope.description: What the audit actually covered, so a partial audit is not mistaken for a clean one.

unsourced_numbers.searched: tuning/best_suite/*/perf.json and figures/out metadata; the highest speedup on disk is 1.64x

mismatches.detail: ph-cost-per-round is registered open but no \ph site carries it, so the paper promises a measurement it never shows.

issues.what: Claims a 2.3x geomean speedup over the released library.
issues.fix: Replace 2.3x with 1.64x, or add the missing suite that produces 2.3x and cite it.

issues.what: States the tuner 'always finds a valid configuration within budget'.
issues.evidence: no file establishes this claim; the round records in tuning/logs show 4 of 30 operators exhausting the budget.
issues.fix: Qualify to the 26 of 30 where it holds, and state the budget exhaustion in §5.5 limitations.

terminology_pairs: 'tile descriptor' (§3.1) vs 'tile spec' (§4.2, §5.1) — one concept, two names
example.checked_scope: Full body, tables 1-3, and all figure captions. The appendix was not audited this round.
